context: Two teens chat about summer plans
purpose: Teach: 太陽光/リモコン/ヘア/サマー/水着/コーラス/熱中/ナチュラル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏休み、太陽光発電施設の見学、行きたい。
lines.en: I want to go see a solar power plant over summer break.
lines.style: Eager, genuine interest cutting through. Quick-paced opening. Leans forward slightly in posture. The tone of someone inviting you into something she actually cares about.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うちのエアコン、リモコン古くて、効きが微妙。
lines.en: Our AC remote's ancient — barely works half the time.
lines.style: Dry observation with underlying exasperation. Measured delivery. Slight shrug in the voice. Not complaining, just stating fact with quiet frustration underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ヘアスタイル、夏向けに変えようかな。
lines.en: I'm thinking about cutting my hair for summer.
lines.style: Playful uncertainty. Light, testing tone — half asking permission, half thinking out loud. Upward lilt at the end. Energy's bright but exploratory, not demanding.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: サマーキャンプ、近所であるって。
lines.en: There's a summer camp happening nearby, apparently.
lines.style: Casual mention, almost offhand. Even pace, relaxed shoulders. Sharing information more than pitching — leave it or take it. Slight distance in the delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: プール用の水着、買い替えたよ。
lines.en: I bought a new swimsuit for the pool.
lines.style: Light, straightforward delivery. Bright without forcing it. Opening note is direct and simple. A small moment of contentment — not exuberant, just satisfied.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 吹奏楽部のコーラス練習、長引いてる。
lines.en: Band chorus practice has been running late.
lines.style: Quiet tiredness underneath. Slower pace. Soft attack on the opening word. Not complaining — observing. The tone of someone who's been thinking about something for a while.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 夏は熱中症、本当に気をつけて。
lines.en: You really have to watch out for heatstroke in summer.
lines.style: Gentle concern without lecturing. Protective undertone — the friend who notices when you're not taking care of yourself. Steady, even delivery. Care underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ナチュラルな日焼け止め、肌に優しいよね。
lines.en: Natural sunscreen is kinder to your skin.
lines.style: Practical advice delivered warmly. Settled, confident tone — she knows this matters. Not dismissive of other options, just sharing what works. Close, familiar register.
